remarks: **Welcome to Eastside Commons!** This premier 2-bedroom, 2-bath loft is just steps away from downtown. The unit boasts vaulted ceilings that flood the space with natural light, overlooking a beautifully maintained courtyard. The kitchen is equipped with dark maple cabinets, granite countertops, and a spacious island. The primary bedroom features an ensuite bathroom, 9-foot ceilings, sliders to a private balcony, and a large walk-in closet. The loft area overlooks the living space and includes a separate room with endless possibilities. Building amenities include a concierge, fitness center, and a well-landscaped courtyard located on the 2nd floor. The unit has been freshly painted with new high-end vinyl flooring installed.
